### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                                                                              |
| ----- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| ~     | *n.*   | fight, battle, combat, conflict, challenge, contest, competition, opposition, attack |
| ~en   | *v.*   | to fight, compete, oppose, attack                                                    |
| ~a    | *psv.* | attacked, opposed, challenged                                                        |
| ~an   | *adj.* | competitive, hostile, opposing                                                       |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
鬥, two people engaged in wrestling each other
#### Sound
- *a priori:* ks=destruction, a=energy
